newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on firm cash markets.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on firm cash markets.

text.p: Firm cash markets and steady mill and export demand boosted CBOT rice futures to a higher close, traders said.
"The cash market is firm and that's what boosted futures today," a trader said.
Traders said the rising rice futures market was bringing in supplies but the demand remains good.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 350 contracts, above the 334 contracts traded Monday.
Rice futures closed three to 10 cents per cwt higher, with January up three at $11.38 per cwt.
